scope.cadence: 60-second resampled quote grid, first Quote at or after each UTC minute boundary

resampled_tape.selection_rule: first Quote event at or after each 60-second UTC boundary, source order preserved, all seven days retained

semantic_equivalence_to_recorded_batch.note: The resampled tape was regenerated after the scratch copy was removed. It reproduces the exact recorded batch hashes from CONTROLS_DEV_FUNDING.json, proving the regenerated tape is semantically identical for the control path.

comparison.rule: Compare every report field and every daily-series row of the full 1000-seed BATCH and SEQUENTIAL reports. Only execution, report_hash and resource_usage are excluded because they intentionally differ by execution mode or are telemetry.
comparison.note: The full 1000-seed sequential execution is now complete and equal to the full 1000-seed batch execution. The prior 100-seed subset equality is superseded for this check.
